ITEM 1 | Roasted potato-like chunks, golden-brown with crisp, browned edges and pale yellow interiors, irregular cut pieces about 2-3 cm, some with darker caramelized spots, lightly glossy, clustered on the upper left of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Dark reddish-brown cooked pieces with slightly charred or caramelized surfaces, irregular shapes about 1.5-2.5 cm, mixed among the potato chunks at the top of the plate | 25
ITEM 3 | Scattered orange-red glossy sauce or glaze bits, small smears and flecks about 0.5-1 cm, sitting among the roasted pieces at the top | 8
ITEM 4 | Whole blackberries, glossy dark purple-black drupelets with a bumpy surface, roughly 2-2.5 cm each, about 12 berries clustered in the center-left of the plate, some with small red juice spots | 85
ITEM 5 | Two small pale tan rounded pieces with light speckled surface, smooth and slightly moist look, about 3-4 cm across, sitting on the right side of the plate | 55
ITEM 6 | Small pale golden-brown rounded piece with a darker glazed, browned surface and slight sheen, about 2.5-3 cm across, next to the other right-side pieces | 35
